_meta.author: Mistral Vibe (LLM-authored, feedback-driven revision)
_meta.domain: Customer support tickets for a SaaS product
_meta.prompt: Create an ontology for customer-support tickets for a SaaS product as JSON. Each class has id, label, definition, and optional children (sub-classes). Aim for 3 levels. Make definitions specific enough that a classifier can distinguish siblings.
_meta.revision_notes: heldout_v1 revises the TechnicalAndProduct sub-tree based ONLY on training-set feedback signals from the held-out experiment (baseline v2.0). The single actionable signal was a low-margin BugReport vs IntegrationProblem decision: 'The Slack notifications stopped working after we changed our workspace settings' routed to BugReport at 0.54 vs IntegrationProblem 0.46. The fix sharpens the boundary: BugReport is a defect internal to the product; IntegrationProblem is a connection to a third-party service that broke, including after a change on the third-party side. No other sub-tree was touched. The compound ticket (charged + login + 2FA) is a known irreducible floor and was not addressed.

label: Support Ticket
definition: Any customer-initiated request or inquiry submitted through a support channel (email, chat, portal, in-app).

children.label: Billing and Payments
children.definition: Issues related to money: charges, refunds, invoices, subscriptions, and payment methods.

children.label: Payment Failure
children.definition: A payment attempt was declined, failed to process, or the card on file has expired. Includes duplicate charges and transaction errors.

children.label: Refund Request
children.definition: Customer wants money returned for a product, service, or charge they believe was in error. Includes pro-rated refunds and goodwill refunds.

children.label: Subscription Change
children.definition: Customer wants to upgrade, downgrade, pause, or cancel their subscription plan, or switch billing cycle (monthly to annual).

children.label: Invoice or Billing Question
children.definition: Customer has a question about an invoice, charge, or billing statement that is not a payment failure or refund request. Includes tax questions and charge explanations.

children.label: Technical and Product
children.definition: Issues related to the product's functionality, bugs, integrations, feature gaps, and performance.

children.label: Bug Report
children.definition: Customer reports unexpected behavior, an error message, a crash, or something in the product itself not working as documented or expected. The problem is internal to the product's own code or behavior. If the issue is a broken connection to a third-party service (Slack, Salesforce, Zapier, webhooks, SSO provider), use IntegrationProblem instead.

children.label: Feature Request
children.definition: Customer asks for a new feature, enhancement, or capability that does not currently exist in the product. Includes workflow improvements.

children.label: Integration or API Problem
children.definition: Customer has difficulty connecting the product with a third-party service, API, webhook, or data sync. Includes notifications or data that stopped flowing from a third-party service, broken connections after a change on the third-party side (e.g., workspace settings, tokens, permissions), and authentication errors on the integration side. If a previously working integration broke after the customer changed settings on the third-party service, this is an integration problem, not a product bug.

children.label: Performance Issue
children.definition: Customer reports the product is slow, unresponsive, or lagging, but it is not crashing or producing errors. Includes timeout and load-time complaints.

children.label: Account and Access
children.definition: Issues related to account login, permissions, security, and user management.

children.label: Login Problem
children.definition: Customer cannot log in to their account. Includes incorrect password, expired session, MFA/2FA issues, and SSO failures.

children.label: Access or Permission Request
children.definition: Customer needs permissions, roles, or access to features, workspaces, or data they currently cannot reach. Includes seat additions and team member invitations.

children.label: Security Concern
children.definition: Customer suspects unauthorized access, a breach, phishing related to the product, or has a security question. Includes data privacy and GDPR requests.

children.label: Account Management
children.definition: Customer wants to change account settings that are not access or security related. Includes profile updates, email address changes, and account deletion requests.
